```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here("analysis", "config.R"))
list2env(load_tables(), envir = globalenv())

has_adjacent <- has_rows(adjacent_sim)

# Statistics this notebook reports, written as LaTeX macros at the end
# (writing/manuscript/stats/exploratory.tex)
macros <- list()
```

```{r dataset-banner, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
dataset_banner(games = games)
```

```{r prep-data}
# Add condition and a block number that runs across both phases (blockNum
# resets per phase; add_global_block() uses each game's own Phase 1 length)
utts_with_condition <- speaker_utts |> add_condition(games) |> add_global_block(games)

# Listener trials of both phases under the response-opportunity rule
# (code_accuracy() via listener_trials(): timeouts and late arrivals are 0,
# trials without an opportunity leave the denominator)
listeners_with_condition <- bind_rows(
  listener_trials(trials, games, phase = 1),
  listener_trials(trials, games, phase = 2)
) |>
  filter(!is.na(correct)) |>
  add_global_block(games)

if (has_adjacent) {
  adj_with_condition <- adjacent_sim |> add_condition(games) |> add_global_block(games)
}
```

# 1. Temporal dynamics: full game

The trajectories of description length, referential accuracy and adjacent
similarity over all twelve blocks are drawn outside this notebook from the
tables prepared above; the endpoint macros below summarize them.

# 2. UMAP projections

```{r umap-projections}
# The UMAP projections of the speaker descriptions, drawn outside this notebook
umap_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "umap_projections.csv")
has_umap <- file.exists(umap_file)

if (has_umap) {
  umap_data <- read_csv(umap_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Add condition from games if not present
  if (!"condition" %in% names(umap_data)) {
    umap_data <- umap_data |>
      left_join(games |> select(gameId, condition), by = "gameId")
  }

  umap_data <- umap_data |>
    mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_ORDER),
      phase_label = ifelse(phaseNum == 1, "Phase 1", "Phase 2")
    )

  cat(sprintf("%d projected descriptions in %d games\n", nrow(umap_data), n_distinct(umap_data$gameId)))
} else {
  cat("No UMAP projections file found. Run compute_derived.py first.\n")
}
```


# 3. Phase 1 conventions across all four conditions

The preregistered H3a test compares final Phase 1 group-specificity in
`social_first` with `social_mixed` only, and the convention-formation checks
pool the three conditions with the shared Phase 1 procedure. Neither shows the
four conditions side by side. This section does, descriptively: the game-level
Phase 1 endpoint estimates and the length of final Phase 1 descriptions, by
condition. Nothing here is a test.

```{r phase1-all-conditions}
if (has_rows(pairwise_sim)) {
  gs_p1_all <- game_specificity_table(pairwise_sim, games, windows = "phase1_final") |>
    filter(estimable)
  p1_gs_by_condition <- gs_p1_all |>
    group_by(condition, .drop = FALSE) |>
    summarise(games = n(), mean = mean(coefficient), sd = sd(coefficient), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(games > 0)
  print(knitr::kable(p1_gs_by_condition, digits = 3,
                     caption = "Final Phase 1 group-specificity by condition (game-level estimates)"))
}

# Final Phase 1 descriptions (each game's last three Phase 1 blocks): words per
# description, averaged within game first so every game counts once
p1_final_len <- phase1_utterances(speaker_utts) |>
  add_condition(games) |>
  group_by(gameId) |>
  filter(blockNum >= max(blockNum) - 2) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(condition, gameId) |>
  summarise(words = mean(uttLength, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
p1_len_by_condition <- p1_final_len |>
  group_by(condition, .drop = FALSE) |>
  summarise(games = n(), mean_words = mean(words), sd = sd(words), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(games > 0)
print(knitr::kable(p1_len_by_condition, digits = 2,
                   caption = "Words per description in the final three Phase 1 blocks, by condition (game means)"))
```

# Statistics for the manuscript

This notebook is descriptive: it reports trajectories and embedding
projections rather than hypothesis tests, so the macros it writes to
`writing/manuscript/stats/exploratory.tex` are the observation counts and the
endpoint means the figures rest on. Names are prefixed `exploratory`.

```{r write-stats}
# The mean of a measure in its own first and last observed block, with the two
# block numbers, so a measure that only starts once a pair of descriptions
# exists (adjacent similarity) is not reported as missing in block 0.
endpoint_macros <- function(prefix, df, value, digits = 3) {
  d <- df |> filter(is.finite(.data[[value]]), !is.na(globalBlock))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(list())
  first <- min(d$globalBlock)
  last <- max(d$globalBlock)
  setNames(
    list(
      fmt_count(nrow(d)),
      first,
      last,
      fmt_stat(mean(d[[value]][d$globalBlock == first]), digits),
      fmt_stat(mean(d[[value]][d$globalBlock == last]), digits)
    ),
    paste0(prefix, c("N", "FirstBlock", "LastBlock", "First", "Last"))
  )
}

macros <- c(
  macros,
  endpoint_macros("exploratoryLength", utts_with_condition, "uttLength", digits = 2),
  endpoint_macros("exploratoryAccuracy", listeners_with_condition, "correct"),
  if (exists("adj_with_condition")) {
    endpoint_macros("exploratorySimAdjacent", adj_with_condition, "simAdjacent")
  } else {
    list()
  }
)
if (exists("has_umap") && has_umap) {
  macros <- c(macros, list(
    exploratoryNUmapPoints = fmt_count(nrow(umap_data))
  ))
}

# Phase 1 endpoints across all four conditions (descriptive):
# exploratoryPhaseOneGsReferSeparatedMean and so on
if (exists("p1_gs_by_condition")) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(p1_gs_by_condition))) {
    cond <- condition_macro_name(p1_gs_by_condition$condition[i])
    macros <- c(macros, setNames(
      list(
        p1_gs_by_condition$games[i],
        fmt_stat(p1_gs_by_condition$mean[i]),
        fmt_stat(p1_gs_by_condition$sd[i])
      ),
      paste0("exploratoryPhaseOneGs", cond, c("N", "Mean", "SD"))
    ))
  }
}
if (exists("p1_len_by_condition")) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(p1_len_by_condition))) {
    cond <- condition_macro_name(p1_len_by_condition$condition[i])
    macros <- c(macros, setNames(
      list(fmt_stat(p1_len_by_condition$mean_words[i], 2)),
      paste0("exploratoryPhaseOneWords", cond)
    ))
  }
}

write_stats_tex(macros, stats_file("exploratory"), source = "analysis/04_exploratory.qmd")
```
